```shell
kubectl rollout undo deployment/nginx-deployment
```

```shell
kubectl rollout undo deployment/nginx-deployment --to-revision=2
```

After rolling back, check if the rollback was successful and the Deployment is running as expected by running:
```shell
kubectl get deployment nginx-deployment
```

reviews.answer: Setting a Deployment's `.spec.revisionHistoryLimit` to 0 will result in cleaning up all the history of your Deployment, thus that Deployment will not be able to roll back [S1]. In this case, a new Deployment rollout cannot be undone, since its revision history is cleaned up [S2].

review_method.purpose: Development evaluation; not independent human or held-out benchmark
review_method.required_facts: Binary, strict all qualifications. NIST Q04 fact 2 requires explicit guidance on practices/controls; generic online-resources mention is insufficient.
review_method.claims: Atomic semantic units, including commands; repeated factual assertions counted as separate occurrences. Introductory framing is excluded.
review_method.citation_attachment: Sentence-local citations; a marker after a code block covers that command. A group at sentence end covers its atomic claims. Noncanonical but intelligible markers are recognized semantically and penalized in format.
review_method.coverage: An atomic claim is covered if at least one attached source fully supports it; wrong extra sources reduce precision.
review_method.refusal: N/A citation metrics when no factual answer claims; false refusal penalized separately.
review_method.format: Canonical source labels, sentence-local claims, citations immediately after valid code blocks, no A/B mode labels.
review_method.limitations: No exhaustive relevant-chunk labels: Recall/Precision/MRR/NDCG are not calculated.
